title: ?author= filter is not URL-decoded and consumes the rest of the query string
evidence: book_service.cpp:132 `author = target.substr(q + 8)` takes everything after ?author= to end-of-string with no percent-decoding, so authors containing '+', '%20', or a trailing '&other=' param mismatch
suggestion: URL-decode the value and stop at the next '&' delimiter

title: Tests are a single monolithic driver, not discrete named cases
evidence: tests.cpp:6 one main() with 6 sequential assertions returning distinct exit codes (1-6); covers health/validation/create/filter/update/delete
suggestion: Optionally split into named test cases or a framework for finer-grained pass/fail reporting; count still exceeds the >=3 requirement
